steps.note: the API built this case's state

Confirm the Events list and its Create Event control rendered without an error.

Use the event's documented Copy control as the closest available clone action.
Check whether copying the withdrawn event navigates to a newly created draft.
Confirm the Events list rendered before locating the draft.
Switch to the Drafts tab for the draft-project refusal case.
